"""A file pytest collects by its `test_` prefix, which lydite scores nothing
of. It branches, so a walk that reached it is recognisable by what it reports.
"""

from probe import classify


def band(n):
    if n < 0:
        return "under"
    return "over" if n > 10 else "within"


def test_classify_names_each_band():
    assert classify(0) == "zero"
    assert band(-1) == "under"
